g.title: Recovery and diagnostics: 5/13, applicable 5/9, and 2 newer than WDDM 2.9 (not targeted yet)

rect.title: DxgkDdiResetFromTimeout: done - does work. Applicable: TDR: the driver must still implement it.
DxgkDdiRestartFromTimeout: done - forwards to WddmAdapterRestart: does work. Applicable: TDR: the driver must still implement it.
DxgkDdiQueryDependentEngineGroup: done - does work. Applicable: Per-engine TDR: mandatory for a full graphics driver from WDDM 1.2.
DxgkDdiQueryEngineStatus: done - does work. Applicable: Per-engine TDR: mandatory for a full graphics driver from WDDM 1.2.
DxgkDdiResetEngine: done - does work. Applicable: Per-engine TDR: mandatory for a full graphics driver from WDDM 1.2.

DxgkDdiCollectDbgInfo: missing - only logs, counts, reads or writes zeros. Applicable: In the minimum DDI set that the docs require even of a compute-only (MCDM) driver. A full graphics driver needs it too.
DxgkDdiQueryDiagnosticTypesSupport: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Applicable: WDDM 2.4 display diagnostics; dxgkrnl asks for it together with ControlDiagnosticReporting.
DxgkDdiControlDiagnosticReporting: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Applicable: WDDM 2.4 display diagnostics; dxgkrnl asks for it together with QueryDiagnosticTypesSupport.
DxgkDdiCollectDiagnosticInfo: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Applicable: WDDM 2.7 and later drivers must support the black screen diagnostic through it.
DxgkDdiCancelCommand: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Cancel support: optional; called only with CancelCommandAware set.
DxgkDdiNotifySurpriseRemoval: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Surprise removal support: optional.
DxgkDdiResetHwEngine: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Hardware scheduling (HAGS): an optional feature that the driver must report before dxgkrnl calls these DDIs.
DxgkDdiResumeHwEngine: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Hardware scheduling (HAGS): an optional feature that the driver must report before dxgkrnl calls these DDIs.
DxgkDdiCollectDbgInfo2: newer than WDDM 2.9 (not targeted yet) - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: A WDDM 3.2 driver is not required to implement it; the OS then calls CollectDbgInfo.
DxgkDdiResetDisplayEngine: newer than WDDM 2.9 (not targeted yet) - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: WDDM 3.2 reset of the display engine alone: optional.
DxgkDdiInterruptRoutine: done - returns the answer. Applicable: In the minimum DDI set that the docs require even of a compute-only (MCDM) driver. A full graphics driver needs it too.
DxgkDdiDpcRoutine: done - does work. Applicable: In the minimum DDI set that the docs require even of a compute-only (MCDM) driver. A full graphics driver needs it too.
DxgkDdiControlInterrupt: done - does work. Applicable: VSync interrupt control for flips: FlipOnVSyncMmIo is mandatory from WDDM 1.2.
DxgkDdiControlInterrupt2: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Applicable: VSync control of WDDM 1.3 and later. The OS uses it when the driver does not implement ControlInterrupt3.
DxgkDdiControlInterrupt3: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Independent VidPn VSync: optional. A WDDM 2.7 driver without it opts out.
DxgkDdiSetInterruptTargetPresentId: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Hardware flip queue: an optional display feature, used only when the driver opts in.
DxgkDdiSetVideoProtectedRegion: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Content protection: an optional feature.
DxgkDdiCreateProtectedSession: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Content protection: an optional feature.
DxgkDdiDestroyProtectedSession: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Optional: Content protection: an optional feature.
DxgkDdiSetTargetAnalogCopyProtection: missing - NULL in WddmBuildTable. Not applicable: Analog copy protection works only on analog targets. The BC-250 and current AMD boards have no analog output.
